bias.en: Downtrend · lost $181, back toward the $173 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $181，回落至 $173 低点附近

read.en: Arm fell 3.1% on Nov 19 to $177.17, trading $176.47–190.65 on light volume (0.65x the 20-day average) after opening at the high. It is below the 5-day ($181.8), 10-day ($185.4), 30-day ($210.6) and 100-day ($255.2), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($234.3). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($195.55), and RSI is 38.2.
read.zh: Arm 11月19日下跌 3.1%，收于 $177.17，开盘即为高点，盘中区间 $176.47–190.65，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.65 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$181.8）、10 日（$185.4）、30 日（$210.6）和 100 日均线（$255.2）下方，四者均在下行，也低于上行的 200 日均线（$234.3）。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$195.55），RSI 为 38.2。

read.en: The $190.65 open faded below the $188.4–191.7 band, and the close broke the $180.5–181.5 support, now resistance. Resistance is $180.5–181.8 (Nov 13 and 18 lows, 5-day), then $184.9–186.3 (Nov 17 high, 10-day, Nov 9 close) and $190.7–195.6 (Nov 18–19 highs, SAR). Support is $173.2–175.1 (Nov 17 low, Nov 6 and 16 closes), then $163–167 (Nov 5). A close above $181.8 would target $185–186; below $173.2, $163–167.
